titulo_original: La coca: Buen vivir del pueblo Nasa

sinopsis.es: En el resguardo Kiwnas Cxhab, el pueblo Nasa cuenta lo que la hoja de coca significa para su vida. Ante la erradicación forzada, defiende sus saberes y el derecho a decidir sobre su territorio.
sinopsis.en: In the Kiwnas Cxhab resguardo, a collectively owned Indigenous territory, the Nasa people share what the coca leaf means to their life. In the face of forced eradication, they defend their knowledge and their right to decide over their territory.
